decision.rationale: I'm escalating this case to a specialist because the payment meets the unauthorised rule but the credit would be above the limit for automated credit. The transaction TXN-007995 for 4,146.81 EUR at COPPERLEAF JOURNEYS (MER-000061) was posted on 2026-09-27 to card CRD-000162. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-26, 29 days later, so it is within the 120-day time limit (time-limits). Authorisation AUTH-008195 shows entry mode ECOMMERCE, 3-D Secure NOT_PERFORMED, CVV NOT_PRESENT, no PIN and the fraud flag set. Under unauthorised-card-not-present, that counts as an unauthorised payment, and the credit would be the full 414,681 minor units. The card has no earlier transactions at this merchant: TXN-007995 is the only one. The provisional-credit section says the automated process never grants credit above 3,000.00 EUR and that such cases go to a specialist, who decides. So I propose no action.
